title: Paramananda@NLU of Devanagari Script Languages 2025: Detection of Language, Hate Speech and Targets using FastText and BERT
description: Comparative analysis of FastText and BERT architectures for multi-task Natural Language Understanding across 5 Devanagari script languages (Nepali, Marathi, Sanskrit, Bhojpuri, Hindi). Evaluates language identification, hate speech detection, and target attribution.

title: PSGS@2026: From Figures to Citation Graphs: QLoRA Based Multimodal Linking for AstroCLIMB
venue: 4th Workshop on AI for Scientific Publications (WASP) @ AACL-IJCNLP / OpenReview
description: Shared task system description paper for AstroCLIMB. Reconstructed scientific citation and structural graphs purely from illustrations, figures, and captions without metadata access by fine-tuning vision-language foundation models via QLoRA.

title: Nepali Lemmatization with Multilingual Transformers: Intrinsic and Extrinsic Evaluation in a Low-Resource Setting
description: Investigated neural morphological analysis and lemmatization for low-resource Nepali using multilingual text-to-text sequence generation transformers (mBART-50, mT5-base/small) with comprehensive intrinsic and downstream extrinsic evaluations.

title: Opinionated Hindi-Nepali Cross-Lingual Corpus & Word Sense Disambiguation (CL-WSD)
description: Co-engineered a high-quality parallel corpus comprising 20,000 Hindi-Nepali sentence pairs. Established benchmark evaluation protocols for Cross-Lingual Word Sense Disambiguation to evaluate pivot-based transfer learning.

title: Optimized Real-Time Nepali Text-to-Speech (TTS) Inference Engine
description: Re-engineered the neural inference architecture for Nepali acoustic speech synthesis. Slashed inference latency by 97.5% (from 80 seconds down to 2 seconds) while maintaining natural prosody and acoustic clarity.

title: ASR Acoustic Bootstrapping via Automated Pseudo-Subtitle Curation
description: Engineered an automated data-harvesting engine that curates, filters, and aligns pseudo-subtitles from online media to expand acoustic training datasets for Nepali Automatic Speech Recognition.
